description: This source file contains test cases for the PyTorch profiler, including tests for CUDA profiling, Kineto events, multi-threading, memory profiling, profiling configuration, and trace exports. It also includes tests for profiling various operations, module hierarchies, and advanced features like concrete inputs and high-level trace collection.
